basic_details.job_title: Kudumbashree Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 14 IFC Anchor, Senior CRP Posts
basic_details.short_information: Kudumbashree (കുടുംബശ്രീ), Kollam is filling 14 posts in eight CDSs of Kollam district: 6 IFC Anchor posts and 8 Senior CRP posts under the Integrated Farming Cluster (IFC) scheme. Applications must reach the District Mission Coordinator, Kudumbashree District Mission Office, Anandavalleeswaram, Kollam 13 by 7 November 2026. You can send them by post or hand them in. The posts pay an honorarium and last three years.

qualification.details: For each of the four new clusters, the notice fills one IFC Anchor post and one Senior CRP post. The rest are existing vacancies: Senior CRP posts in the Pooyappally, Kulakkada, Edamulakkal and Thalavoor CDSs, and IFC Anchor posts in the Kulakkada and Thalavoor CDSs. | Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Agriculture, Allied Science, with one year's work experience in agriculture or farm-based livelihood. Preference: candidates with work experience in extension and marketing. If no candidates with this qualification are available, candidates with Plus Two/VHSE (Agri) will be considered. These candidates must have two years' work experience in the agricultural sector. Candidates from the block and grama panchayats concerned will get preference. Pay: honorarium basis. The notice does not mention the amount. | Experience: two years' work experience as a Krishi Sakhi, Pashu Sakhi or Agri CRP. The notice does not mention the amount. | Check the official notification for the full eligibility details of each post.

content_sections.heading: About Kudumbashree Kollam
content_sections.text: The Kudumbashree District Mission Office in Kollam is headed by the District Mission Coordinator. It is located on the floor above the Civil Supplies Office at Anandavalleeswaram, Kollam. In the 2026-27 financial year, it is starting four Integrated Farming Clusters (IFCs) under the Chathannoor, Poruvazhi, Panayam and Thevalakkara CDSs. These CDSs come under the Ithikkara, Sasthamcotta, Chittumala and Chavara blocks.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Write your application on white paper. Attach your biodata, copies of your certificates and a certificate from your CDS. Send the application by post or hand it in at this address by 7 November 2026: District Mission Coordinator, Kudumbashree District Mission Office, Upper Floor of Civil Supplies Office, Anandavalleeswaram, Kollam 13 The notice does not give an application form or say what to write on the envelope. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: For each of the four new clusters, the notice fills one IFC Anchor post and one Senior CRP post. The rest are existing vacancies: Senior CRP posts in the Pooyappally, Kulakkada, Edamulakkal and Thalavoor CDSs, and IFC Anchor posts in the Kulakkada and Thalavoor CDSs. Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Agriculture, Allied Science, with one year's work experience in agriculture or farm-based livelihood. Preference: candidates with work experience in extension and marketing. If no candidates with this qualification are available, candidates with Plus Two/VHSE (Agri) will be considered. These candidates must have two years' work experience in the agricultural sector. Candidates from the block and grama panchayats concerned will get preference. Pay: honorarium basis. The notice does not mention the amount. Experience: two years' work experience as a Krishi Sakhi, Pashu Sakhi or Agri CRP. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification for the Senior CRP post. Preference: candidates who have completed the training for CRPs. Pay: honorarium basis. The notice does not mention the amount. Check the official notification for the full eligibility details of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Kudumbashree Kollam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 14 vacancies: 6 IFC Anchor posts and 8 Senior CRP posts, spread across eight CDSs in Kollam district.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Your application must reach the Kudumbashree District Mission Office in Kollam by 7 November 2026, by post or in person.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IFC Anchor post?
faq.answer: You need a Degree/Diploma in Agriculture, Allied Science and one year's work experience in agriculture or farm-based livelihood. If no such candidates are available, candidates with Plus Two/VHSE (Agri) and two years' experience in the agricultural sector will be considered.

faq.question: Q4. Who can apply for the Senior CRP post?
faq.answer: You need two years' work experience as a Krishi Sakhi, Pashu Sakhi or Agri CRP. Candidates who have completed the training for CRPs get preference.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Write your application on white paper. Attach your biodata, copies of your certificates (education/experience, Kudumbashree membership, identity) and a certificate from your CDS. Send it by post or hand it in to the District Mission Coordinator, Kudumbashree District Mission Office, Upper Floor of Civil Supplies Office, Anandavalleeswaram, Kollam 13, by 7 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are for three years, the length of the IFC scheme. There is an appraisal every year, and candidates who perform well are given continued appointment.

faq.question: Q7. Which CDSs have IFC Anchor vacancies?
faq.answer: Chathannoor, Poruvazhi, Panayam, Thevalakkara, Kulakkada and Thalavoor have one IFC Anchor post each. Senior CRP posts are in these six CDSs and also in Pooyappally and Edamulakkal.

faq.question: Q8. Who gets preference for the IFC Anchor post?
faq.answer: Preference goes to candidates with extension and marketing work experience, and to candidates from the block and grama panchayats concerned.
